description: Implementation of the recommendations of the Committee appointed to Review the Recruitment Process and Cadre Management in the Public Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2024 12 30, granted approval to appoint an Officials’ Committee under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Prime Minister to review the recruitment process in the Public Service, identify needs, priorities and time frames and submit recommendations regarding the number of recruitments essential to be made in this regard. Recommendations submitted by the Officials’ Committee having considered the requests forwarded to the said Committee by the respective Ministries to fill the vacancies in the Departments and other Institutions falling under the said Ministries at its meeting held on 2026 02 12, were submitted to the Cabinet by the Hon. Prime Minister and the approval of the Cabinet was granted to the following recruitments.
